claims.statement: ServiceNow documentation provides product and release context, and available capabilities depend on the license.
ServiceNow data readiness guidance emphasizes complete task records, structured knowledge, catalog review, and evaluation.
ServiceNow governance guidance distinguishes governance responsibilities and human oversight from feature availability.
